name: PHQ-9 Depression Screening
description: Nine-question depression screener with an automatic total score and severity band (minimal to severe).
scoring: Each answer scores 0–3. The total (0–27) maps to minimal (0–4), mild (5–9), moderate (10–14), moderately severe (15–19) or severe (20–27) depression.
source: Kroenke, Spitzer & Williams 2001, J Gen Intern Med 16:606 (PHQ-9). Codes: LOINC; form text as published at phqscreeners.com.

name: GAD-7 Anxiety Screening
description: Seven-question generalized anxiety screener with an automatic total score and severity band (minimal to severe).
scoring: Each answer scores 0–3. The total (0–21) maps to minimal (0–4), mild (5–9), moderate (10–14) or severe (15–21) anxiety.
source: Spitzer et al. 2006, Arch Intern Med 166:1092 (GAD-7). Codes: LOINC; form text as published at phqscreeners.com.
license: Developed by Drs. Robert L. Spitzer, Janet B.W. Williams, Kurt Kroenke and colleagues, with an educational grant from Pfizer Inc. No permission required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute.

name: AUDIT-C Alcohol Use Screening
description: Three-question alcohol consumption screen with an automatic total score (0–12) and the usual positive-screen thresholds.
scoring: Each answer scores 0–4. The total (0–12) is a positive screen at 4 or more for men and 3 or more for women.
source: Bush et al. 1998, Arch Intern Med 158:1789 (AUDIT-C, from the WHO AUDIT). Codes and answer lists: LOINC, as in the HL7 US Core AUDIT-C questionnaire.
license: No restrictions on use (per the ONC USCDI/ISP listing; submitted by NIAAA).

name: PHQ-2 Depression Screening
description: Two-question depression screener with an automatic total and positive-screen flag; the short entry to the PHQ-9.
scoring: Each answer scores 0–3. The total (0–6) is a positive screen at 3 or more.
source: Kroenke, Spitzer & Williams 2003, Med Care 41:1284 (PHQ-2). Codes: LOINC; form text as published at phqscreeners.com.
license: Developed by Drs. Robert L. Spitzer, Janet B.W. Williams, Kurt Kroenke and colleagues, with an educational grant from Pfizer Inc. No permission required to reproduce, translate, display or distribute.

name: GAD-2 Anxiety Screening
description: Two-question anxiety screener with an automatic total and positive-screen flag; the short entry to the GAD-7.
scoring: Each answer scores 0–3. The total (0–6) is a positive screen at 3 or more.
source: Kroenke et al. 2007, Ann Intern Med 146:317 (GAD-2). Codes: LOINC; form text as published at phqscreeners.com.
